gloss: outbreak of war; start of hostilities

definitions.gloss: outbreak of war; start of hostilities; commencement of battle
definitions.explanation: The beginning of armed conflict or war. Refers to the moment fighting officially starts between nations or forces.

examples.japanese: {開戦|かいせん}の{知|し}らせが{届|とど}いた。
examples.english: News of the outbreak of war arrived.

examples.japanese: {外交|がいこう}{交渉|こうしょう}が{決裂|けつれつ}し、{開戦|かいせん}に{至|いた}った。
examples.english: Diplomatic negotiations broke down and led to the outbreak of war.

examples.japanese: {開戦|かいせん}から{七十年|ななじゅうねん}が{経|た}った{今|いま}でも、{戦争|せんそう}の{記憶|きおく}は{人々|ひとびと}の{心|こころ}に{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: Even seventy years after the war began, memories of the conflict remain in people's hearts.

notes:
A compound of {開|かい} (to open, to start) and {戦|せん} (war, battle).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開戦|かいせん}に{踏|ふ}み{切|き}る (to decide to go to war)
- {開戦|かいせん}に{至|いた}る (to lead to war)
- {開戦|かいせん}{直前|ちょくぜん} (just before the outbreak of war)
- {開戦|かいせん}{当初|とうしょ} (at the start of the war)
- {開戦|かいせん}を{回避|かいひ}する (to avoid war)

The antonym is {終戦|しゅうせん} (end of war). Related terms include {宣戦|せんせん} (declaration of war) and {休戦|きゅうせん} (ceasefire).
